launches.title: Martini Bar: AI video production infrastructure
launches.tagline: Give Claude a real workspace for making videos
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Martini Bar gives AI agents and vibe coded tools **one video production workspace** for **collaboration**, **asset management**, and **cost tracking**. It’s Martini’s **API**, **MCP**, and **CLI** product for serious video teams.

**Ask:** If you build your own AI video tools or make video with agents, connect to Martini Bar this week at [https://www.martini.film/bar](http://martini.film/bar%5D\(https://www.martini.film/bar\)) and tell us what's missing.

<https://youtu.be/nNKBL_w36ag>

---

# **🍸 The problem**

Professionals are making AI videos for TV spots, episodic series and brand campaigns. Many teams run workflows on pipelines and tools they stitched together: a script breakdown tool built with Claude Code, a character library built with Lovable.

It’s great that people are building their own video tools.

**But three things are hard to build right:**

1. **Collaboration.** An agent's output is a folder of files. Vibe coded tools tend to be for one user.
2. **Provenance.** Generative AI video requires lots of iteration. You end up with a mess of assets at the end of production.
3. **Billing.** You have no idea how much everything ended up costing.

We fix this.\
\
One studio told us,

> **What takes us three days in other tools took five hours in Martini."**

---

---

---

# **🛠️ Our solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125185&key=user_uploads/2701033/26d0cdb0-9b2e-4ad4-a387-d359e1ea358e)

Think about what Supabase did for vibe-coded apps.\
Martini Bar does that for AI video. We’re the backbone behind your tools and agents, so you can focus on building what’s unique for your team.

1. **Your team and agents work together.** Everyone works on one canvas and timeline. Everyone can see and edit the same materials.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125185&key=user_uploads/2701033/7539906f-9c6f-4774-9001-77f0222d0d2b)

2. **Every shot remembers how it was made.** It keeps the model, prompt, references, every take that was tried, the edits on top, and the person or agent behind each one.\
     \
   Every project can build on the last project, instead of being a one-off.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125185&key=user_uploads/2701033/ca220adb-5892-4dd9-8480-48bcc8d310da)

3. **Actually understand how much you’re spending.** You can break spend down by person, agent, project and model, and set caps per member and per project.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125185&key=user_uploads/2701033/46a3553a-22c9-4c2c-81a5-6b0ea3f4e195)

4. **Bonus: bring your own fal API key.** Know exactly what you’re paying for with your own API key for generative models.

---

# **🎬 Made with Martini:**

* An animated series with 1M+ views
* TV commercials airing internationally
* Shows for TV networks
* Short-form content for viral consumer apps

# **⚙️ How it works**

Visit [**https://www.martini.film/bar**](http://martini.film/bar%5D\(https://www.martini.film/bar%5C) and get started for free and connect your apps and agents to a real video workspace.

---

# **👋 Who we are**

Koh is a professional cinematographer whose work has screened at [Cannes' Directors' Fortnight](https://www.quinzaine-cineastes.fr/en/film/grand-bouquet). Long was the first growth engineer at [Supabase](https://supabase.com/). Hundreds of films have been made with Martini, airing as TV commercials, gallery work and viral shorts.

# **❓ FAQ**

* **Do I need to have built my own tools?**\
  No. Everything works in the Martini app too. Martini Bar is for when you want your own tools or agents to work on the same shots.
* **Which agents does Martini Bar work with?**\
  Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude and ChatGPT, through our MCP server. Your own code can use the HTTP API (TypeScript and Python clients) or the CLI.
* **What does "bring your own fal key" mean?**\
  Generations bill to your fal.ai account at fal's prices. For models that aren't on fal, you use olives, Martini's credits.
* **Can my editor still finish in Premiere or Resolve?**\
  Yes. Martini exports XML to Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.

👉 **Get started at [https://www.martini.film/bar](http://martini.film/bar%5D\(https://www.martini.film/bar%5C)**, or email [founders@martini.film](mailto:founders@martini.film)

launches.title: Martini: AI Video Production for Professionals
launches.tagline: Your Film Set for AI Videos
launches.body:
**TLDR:** _Martini is a collaborative, professional workspace for creating high-quality AI videos. It’s a film set for AI video production._

<https://youtu.be/E4-astm3zyI>

# **🍸 Introduction**

We’re [Koh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kohterai/) and [Long](https://www.linkedin.com/in/longh/) from Martini.

Generative AI video still feels like the wild west.

Brave members of the creative community are embracing this new medium.\
\
But making a great AI video still feels like fighting the tool rather than using it. Most AI tools are built around prompting and seeds—not the way filmmakers actually think.

Koh is a [professional cinematographer](https://www.quinzaine-cineastes.fr/en/film/grand-bouquet). He knows filmmakers live and breathe on film sets – a space for intentionality, collaboration, and control. Not endless prompts. So we built Martini to give filmmakers an environment to direct and shoot their generative AI films.

We shared Martini with a few filmmaker friends. Then more. Today over [200 films](https://www.madewithmartini.com/) have been made with Martini. They’ve aired as TV Commercials, been displayed as artwork, and have gone viral online.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97320&key=user_uploads/2701033/3a701a0c-9b24-4e63-bdf0-96cac0be92bf)

Our users are filmmakers, artists, serious production teams, and anyone daring enough to take on the challenge of creating AI video.

---

---

# **🍸 Martini is the go-to platform for AI video production**

**Professional Control**\
Get the exact shot you want, not just the one the model hands you. Step into virtual worlds and compose shots using camera position, lenses, and movement — not just prompts and frames.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97320&key=user_uploads/2701033/41b4eb79-44ac-41fc-948f-dcde5b23ad60)

_Step into any image or video to reframe and reshoot_

**Streamlined Production Pipeline**\
Teams are forced to MacGyver their workflows across a mess of tools. Martini brings image, video, and world models directly into the editing process.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97320&key=user_uploads/2701033/3791bdb8-2631-4b1e-8ecf-e0165913cf3f)

_Built in timeline for creating rough assemblies, exportable as XML_

**Production as a Team Sport**\
Video production is collaborative. Different professionals bring different expertise. Martini supports real-time collaboration—sharing prompts, edits, and feedback—so teams can explore ideas together the way they do in tools like **Figma, but for generative film**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97320&key=user_uploads/2701033/f2e831c6-9f6a-4336-9df0-2b6799d6210a)

# Interested?

If you’re a filmmaker, studio, or creative agency taking AI video seriously, book a demo session with us.\
